02 · The opportunity

Your category is having its TikTok Shop moment.

TikTok Shop collapsed the distance between discovery and checkout: a viewer sees a product in their feed and buys it without ever leaving the app. For brands, that means content is the storefront — and the brands that build a content, LIVE, and affiliate engine early are compounding while everyone else is still "testing."

  • Discovery-led buying: the algorithm puts products in front of buyers who never searched for them — shelf space is earned with content, not ad budget.
  • An affiliate ecosystem: thousands of creators will sell your products for commission — a sales force you don't hire.
  • LIVE commerce is the platform's highest-conversion surface — and most brands haven't touched it, which is the opening.

The play

Sell everywhere buyers are: optimized listings, a shoppable-video engine, a LIVE program, and an affiliate creator community — one operating engine behind all four, instead of posting and hoping.

Built in phases, run with your team, and handed over — the engine is yours when we step back.

STUDIOS02

03 · Why we're different

We build it in your house. Then we hand you the keys.

Most agencies are built on dependency: they own your creator relationships, your playbooks, your LIVE operation — and the meter never stops. We think that's a bad deal for brands, and a worse strategy for what's coming.

Social commerce won't stay a one-platform game. Every major platform is building its answer to TikTok Shop. Brands that own their live selling capability, their affiliate program, and their playbooks will port them anywhere. Brands that rented them from an agency will start from zero, again.

Year one

We run it with you — and train your staff on everything we do, including helping you interview and hire the right people.

Year two

Your team runs it. Your creators, your playbooks, your LIVE operation, and the tools we used — transferred to you, portable to any platform.

The proof

Graduated clients can keep the Academy Hub for just $149/mo — or walk away owing nothing. Our model only works if the handover is real.

11 · The launch plan

Launch in focused waves — one engine, four ways to sell.

🏬 ShopTab

Listings optimized to convert the traffic every other channel creates

🎬 Shoppable Video

A content engine tuned to what the algorithm rewards

🔴 LIVE Selling

Programmed shows on the platform's highest-conversion surface

🤝 Affiliates

A creator community selling your products on commission

1 · FOUNDATIONS

Shop setup, listing optimization per line, compliance and shop-health baseline, launch calendar mapped to your brand's own moments (product releases, seasonal peaks, retail dates).

2 · TARGETED AFFILIATE CAMPAIGNS — ONE PER LINE

Each product line gets its own gated affiliate campaign — intentional, targeted creator recruiting via our network + TikTok's creator marketplace, so the right products land with the right creators and their audiences.

3 · CONTENT STRATEGY & TEAM TRAINING

If your brand already has a content team, we don't replace it, we train it: product-linked video formats, hook structures, posting cadence, and what TikTok Shop's algorithm rewards, so your team produces shoppable content in-house from month one.

4 · LAUNCH MOMENTS

Sequenced line premieres: drop-style limited editions, LIVE launch events, product-transformation and unboxing formats, flash deals timed to your calendar.

5 · AMPLIFY & COMPOUND

Ads behind proven organic winners (GMV Max + shoppable video ads), weekly affiliate touchpoints per campaign, winning formats and creators rolled into the next launch.

6 · MEASURE

Per-line scorecards in the Academy Hub: GMV by campaign, creator leaderboards, content performance — reviewed weekly with your team.

12 · The 12-month journey

From launch to keys-in-hand.

MONTHS 1–3

Build & launch

Shop foundations, listings, compliance, first line launches, per-line affiliate campaigns live, content team trained on product-linked video.

MONTHS 4–6

Scale what works

Winning formats compound across product lines; affiliate campaigns grow; ads amplify proven organic winners; your team shadows every function.

MONTHS 7–9

Transfer ownership

Your staff runs point with our team behind them. Hiring support fills the gaps. Playbooks documented in your Academy Hub, tool access transferred.

MONTHS 10–12

Hand over the keys

Your team runs it. We step back — keep the Academy Hub at $149/mo if you want it, add-ons only if you choose them.

Every capability we build is yours — the creator relationships, the LIVE operation, the playbooks, the tools, the data. Portable to whatever platform comes next.
